android.desc:
LYNX Whiteboard isn’t just a drawing canvas—it’s a full-featured cloud ready file manager with built-in whiteboarding tools, designed to help you organize, annotate, and share your documents across all your devices, including USB and external storage.

Why You’ll Love LYNX Whiteboard

- Centralized File Management  
  Browse, organize, and preview PowerPoint, Word, PDF, SMART Notebook, image and video files from your device’s internal storage, SD cards, USB drives, and OTG devices—all from one intuitive interface.

- Rich Media Integration  
  Drag and drop images and video clips from your device’s gallery, USB drives, or other external storage into any whiteboard or document for richer presentations and notes.

- Seamless Local + Cloud Sync  
  Access the same workspace on your phone, tablet, or PC. Work on files stored locally, on external storage, or in LYNX Cloud (or connected cloud services), and pick up right where you left off. Easy move files between local and cloud storage in both directions.

- Integrated Annotation & Sketching  
  Open any document and instantly mark it up—draw, highlight, or write notes directly on your files with a variety of pens, highlighters, and erasers.

- Smart Handwriting Recognition  
  Convert your sketches and notes into editable text instantly, making it easier to search, copy, and share your work.

- Ad-Free, Distraction-Free  
  Focus on your work without interruptions—LYNX Whiteboard is completely free of ads.

quotes.text: Wow, there is just no information at all about it.  A few clicks leads to the user manual, which also assumes you know what it is: https://download.saharasupport.com/Documents/LynxHowToGuide.pdf.  There's a little more information on the app stores, mostly hidden in the loud video: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.clevertouch.lynx, https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/lynx-whiteboard/9np33m4m3r35?activetab=pivot:overviewtab.  It seems to be mainly focused on lesson planning and classroom use.
